text: The purpose of this report is to seek instruction for an OMB Appeal on the above-noted matter. The hearing has not yet been scheduled. There is a one day pre-hearing conference scheduled for April 11, 2017.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council adopt the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (March 21, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor and City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential. 4.
